messages:
morgan: Heads up — ran into a weird mypy/pyright failure with the async Python client and autogenerated pydantic models

morgan: repro outline: generate client from openapi, call async_client.get_widget(...).await and then mypy complains about Union[WidgetA, WidgetB, None] not being iterable when used in a list comprehension

morgan: pasted snippet of generated model:```python
class WidgetResponse(BaseModel):
    items: Optional[Union[List[WidgetA], List[WidgetB]]] = None
```

morgan: error from mypy: "error: Item "None" of "Optional[Union[List[WidgetA], List[WidgetB]]]" has no attribute "__iter__""

sam: is that with strict Optional checks enabled?

morgan: yes, strict optional on, but even without it pyright flags the comprehension because it narrows to Union[List[A], List[B], None] and then code like `[x for lst in resp.items for x in lst]` fails

riya: hm that shape is odd — generator should prefer Union[List[WidgetA], List[WidgetB]] inside Optional, not Union[List[A], List[B]] wrapped then Optional. Can you paste the exact comprehension you used?

morgan: sure:```python
resp = await client.get_widget(...)
all_items = [x for lst in (resp.items or []) for x in lst]
```

morgan: even with the or [] workaround mypy still complains in one of our CI jobs (the older mypy pin)

tom_k: quick thought — autogen is flattening unions incorrectly. Instead of Optional[Union[List[A], List[B]]] it should probably be Optional[Union[List[A], List[B]]] OR better: Optional[List[Union[A, B]]]. The latter is much easier for downstream code and typing tools

riya: +1. Optional[List[Union[A,B]]] matches what users expect when multiple schemas are specified for array items. This is a generator bug in autogen layer.

sam: can we change generator logic without breaking existing users? breaking change risk is real though

morgan: propose: add a compat flag: `prefer_item_union = True|False` default false. When true, generate List[Union[A,B]]; when false, keep current behavior. Document in changelog and opt-in in config

riya: also suggest emitting a type alias e.g. `WidgetItems = List[Union[WidgetA, WidgetB]]` and keep the existing union but mark it with `# type: ignore[assignment]` where necessary. Might reduce churn

tom_k: for short term we should add a CI lint note and a suggested code-level workaround in SDK docs: use `(resp.items or [])` or `cast(List[Union[WidgetA,WidgetB]], resp.items or [])` or `from typing import Iterable; for lst in cast(Iterable, resp.items or []):`

morgan: filing a bug and a small repro in a gist now, will link

ci-bot: New issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/412 — "autogen: array union typing leads to Optional[Union[List[A],List[B]]] instead of Optional[List[Union[A,B]]]" :sparkles:

sam: nice. can you add a minimal test that runs mypy/pyright across a tiny generated package? then we can pin expected behavior in CI

morgan: will do. also noticed pyright accepts the comprehension but mypy stricter — so test should run both

riya: FYI this also affects docs sample apps that do `for item in resp.items:` without guard. Good to add a short note in migration guide

morgan: thanks. assigning to @tom_k to draft a generator PR with feature flag. I'll add repro/test and docs note.

tom_k: ack, will start a branch. small question: do we want to adjust runtime validation too? If we change to List[Union[...]] the OpenAPI validation semantics are the same; it's just type surface change

riya: runtime unaffected. focus on typing ergonomics for now

sam: also consider adding `# pragma: no cover` to generated typing shims? not necessary

morgan: one last thing — observed another mypy complaint when response param types are overloaded in sync vs async clients (sync client returns List[Widget] while async returns AsyncIterator[Widget] in our stubs); mixing annotations causes mypy to pick the wrong overload in some call sites

riya: oh that sounds annoying. we should unify by providing a shared protocol/generic: `class BaseClient(Generic[T]): def list_widgets(self) -> T` then instantiate T for sync/async variants. reduces duplicate overloads

sam: great idea. put that in the SDK typing RFC?

morgan: opened RFC issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/413 — "typing: unify sync/async return shapes with client generics"

ci-bot: build passed on branch morgan/typing-repro (mypy 0.991) :white_check_mark:

riya: leaving a comment on the issue about pyright vs mypy matrix

morgan: thanks all. will follow up with PRs for repro + generator flag + docs sample. If anyone hits this in the meantime add a quick comment on #devex and link the issue

sam: :thumbsup:
